$comment: sherpa-canvas — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: a plane its slotted elements lay out on, each at its own place (its `--x`, `--y`), through the view its attributes set. With `data-drawn`, where the engine draws HTML in a canvas (Chrome 157 on), they are DRAWN into a REAL <canvas>: each stays a live element — its fields take focus and typing, a press where it is drawn reaches it. Will, 2026-11-11 (plan 852: plain unless a page asks). TRAP T-a-canvas-draws-live-html

props.name: data-drawn
props.description: draw into a real canvas, where the engine can (default: a plain layer)

props.name: data-x
props.description: the view's pan across, in px

props.name: data-y
props.description: the view's pan down, in px

slots.description: what it draws: each element at its --x and --y

populate.description: Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.

capabilities.description: callable from a view definition's state block (paint). See $extensions.sherpa.methods.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Draw again, next frame: something the canvas cannot see moved.
